stories.title: Four Flintshire council motions shut out by new three-motion limit
stories.summary: Four motions from Flintshire councillors will not be debated at next week’s full council meeting, because of a limit on motions brought in this year. Under rules agreed by the council in July, no more than three motions can be debated at an ordinary council meeting. If more are submitted, lots are drawn to decide

stories.title: Flintshire roads need £5.2m a year to stop getting worse, but council plans £2m
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council says it needs £5.2m a year to stop the county’s roads getting worse, but its spending plan for the next three years sets aside £2m a year. stories.title: Shotton care home rated good in every area by inspectors
stories.summary: Hollybank Care Home on Shotton Lane was rated good for well-being, care, environment and leadership, with no areas for improvement found.

stories.title: Nine Flintshire postcodes hit by Thursday night power cut
stories.summary: Part of Gwespyr is without power this evening after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 11.20pm.

stories.title: NHS trust says it did not know Betsi review findings when it appointed Carol Shillabeer
stories.summary: Betsi Cadwaladr chief executive Carol Shillabeer has withdrawn from a new job running an NHS trust in England, days after a review found serious failings in the health board’s leadership.
